title: Axolotl holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ecf'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ff4f9a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d62f75'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd0e6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f79ac6'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M60 52 Q64 66 55 78' stroke='#ffe9b0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='34' rx='17' ry='19' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <polygon points='62,52 58,56 66,56' fill='#d62f75'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='27' rx='4.5' ry='6.5' fill='#ffd6ea' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- left arm reaching up to string -->
  <path d='M60 76 Q70 70 63 60' stroke='#f79ac6' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 76 Q70 70 63 60' stroke='#ffd0e6' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M32 80 Q18 76 14 88 Q26 90 36 84 Z' fill='#f79ac6'/>
  <path d='M32 80 Q20 77 16 86' stroke='#ffd0e6' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='72' rx='20' ry='16' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='77' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#fff0f6'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#f79ac6'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#f79ac6'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='88' r='2' fill='#ffd0e6'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='88' r='2' fill='#ffd0e6'/>

  <!-- gills left -->
  <path d='M34 48 Q22 40 18 46' stroke='#ff7db8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M33 56 Q20 54 17 60' stroke='#ff7db8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M35 63 Q25 65 23 71' stroke='#ff7db8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <path d='M62 48 Q74 40 78 46' stroke='#ff7db8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 56 Q76 54 79 60' stroke='#ff7db8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M61 63 Q71 65 73 71' stroke='#ff7db8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='18' ry='15' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fc4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#ff8fc4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='50' r='3.6' fill='#3a1e3d'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='3.6' fill='#3a1e3d'/>
  <circle cx='42.2' cy='48.8' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.2' cy='48.8' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 58 Q48 62 53 58' stroke='#c94f8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d='M34 74 Q24 68 26 60' stroke='#f79ac6' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 74 Q24 68 26 60' stroke='#ffd0e6' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='59' r='4' fill='#f79ac6'/>
</svg>
